'''Philip K.Jone''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
Philip K.Jone is an author with one of his books visible in many [[Save Points in GTA San Andreas|safehouses]].

==Trivia==
*His actual name is cut off from his book. However there is a great possibility that his name is Philip K.Jone'''s'''.
